children.game_version: Follow-the-leader style game using simplified arm movements.

seniors.seated_version: Perform arm gestures while seated, focusing on range of motion.
seniors.standing_version: Perform routines with reduced tempo and minimal foot movement.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo to match comfort levels.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Primary focus; complex, choreographed gestures that follow the melody and rhythm.
movement_profile.footwork: Minimal; includes stepping side-to-side, stepping in place, and occasional hops.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Synchronized group formation, often facing a lead instructor or the front.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Minimal movement, occasionally involving hip shifts.
movement_profile.partnering: None; performed as a solo or group synchronized dance.
movement_profile.posture: Upright and alert, facilitating rapid arm movements.

signature_moves.description: Specific, song-dependent hand and arm gestures performed in unison.
signature_moves.name: Arm sequences

music_profile.sound_description: High-tempo electronic music characterized by driving synthesizer melodies and a steady, repetitive kick drum pattern.
music_profile.vocal_style: Upbeat, energetic, often featuring English-language lyrics.

basic_steps: Step side-to-side in time with the 4/4 beat.
Execute synchronized arm gestures corresponding to the song's specific routine.
Maintain upper body focus while keeping footwork minimal.
Perform the routine in unison with the group.
teaching.formation: Group synchronization, often in lines or facing the front.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on learning the specific arm choreography for a single track before attempting footwork.
